# clearml_project (Resource)

A hierarchical ClearML project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clearml_project" "production" {
  name                       = "platform/production"
  description                = "Production machine-learning workloads"
  tags                       = ["managed-by-terraform", "production"]
  default_output_destination = "s3://clearml-output/production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique full project name. Use slash-separated names for subprojects.

### Optional

- `default_output_destination` (String) Default output destination for new tasks. Omit it to preserve the remote value.
- `description` (String) The project description. Omit it to preserve the remote value.
- `tags` (Set of String) User-defined project tags. Omit them to preserve the remote value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clearml_project.production project-id
```
